subject: Tenant-proxy listing & fallback playbook — CloudRetailer joint demo bundle
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudretailer.com>, Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@cloudretailer.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Tenant-proxy listing & fallback playbook — CloudRetailer joint demo bundle

Hi team,

Thanks for the quick discovery call yesterday — this thread is to capture the ops playbook we agreed to iterate on for the CloudRetailer listing that needs a tenant-proxy approach and a joint demo bundle for co-sell. High-level asks:

- Confirm the preferred listing path for AWS/GCP/Azure (single publisher vs mirrored tenant proxies).
- Define the fallback behavior when a tenant proxy cannot be approved in a region (catalog fallback and co-sell routing).
- Produce a minimal evidence set for the marketplace intake (auth, metering, telemetry hooks).
- Agree demo bundle SKUs and the basic pricing/crediting model for co-sell attribution.

Attached: tenant-proxy-arch.png (high-level architecture), joint-demo-bundle-skus.csv (first draft), fallback-playbook-v1.docx (skeleton).

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben — can you validate the runtime implications for proxying tokens and KV cache across publisher boundaries?
2) Karthik — can you draft a short list of the legal/contract items AWS/Azure will insist on (seller-of-record, metering clauses, data residency notes)?
3) Liam/Sophie — can you confirm whether CloudRetailer prefers a single publisher listing or mirrored tenant proxies per cloud?

Timing: we want a short internal runbook by EOD Wednesday (2026-12-09) so we can prep the partner pack for the AWS SellWith review on Thursday.

Thanks,

Monica

On Mon, Dec 7, 2026 at 9:12 AM Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi team,
> 
> Thanks for the quick discovery call yesterday — this thread is to capture the ops playbook we agreed to iterate on for the CloudRetailer listing that needs a tenant-proxy approach and a joint demo bundle for co-sell.

Thanks Monica — flagged a few practical constraints after a quick scan of the arch:

1) Latency/appearance: tenant-proxy introduce an extra hop for token exchange and prefix/KV warmup. For our production sprints we should spec a cold-start SLA and an expected p50/p95 delta so the partner demo doesn't show token lag.

2) Metering alignment: if CloudRetailer wants mirrored listings (publisher per cloud) we need a clear mapping to attribution signals — recommend we use a joint header (X-Partner-SKU) that both sides propagate to metering to make co-sell attribution deterministic. We'll add that to fallback-playbook-v1.

3) Security evidence: our SOC2-ish artifacts are fine but the marketplaces will ask for a short technical summary (1-2 pages) describing tenant-proxy token flow and KMS use. I'll draft that.

Action: I'll drop a one-page latency matrix and a proposed X-Partner-SKU header spec by EOD tomorrow. Also suggest we add Engineering contact for any API compatibility questions (I can loop in Olga if you want).

-ben

Subject: Re: Tenant-proxy listing & fallback playbook — CloudRetailer joint demo bundle

Monica / Ben / Liam —

Quick legal/ops notes from my side after consulting with PMM and Legal:

- Seller-of-record: CloudRetailer prefers to be seller-of-record in APAC and EMEA markets; for the US they are open to co-seller models. We should prepare two contract exemplars.
- Metering clause: marketplaces will require a statement of metering idempotency and reconciliation cadence (monthly). Add that to the intake evidence.
- Data residency: if tenant proxy lives in a different cloud region we need to document (a) which telemetry is cross-border and (b) consent/controls. Keep the list minimal.

I've attached a short procurement checklist (excerpt pasted below) and added a suggested cadence for the partner pack review:

Procurement checklist (short):
- Publisher contact & billing entity
- Metering id and mapping table (SKU->internal usage id)
- Basic security summary (1-page) + SOC2 link
- Demo bundle SKU list + crediting model
- Approved sample T&Cs for SellWith (AWS)/Co-sell (GCP/Azure)

Cadence proposal:
- Tue 12/8: internal runbook draft (Redwood ops)
- Wed 12/9: partner pack (w/ CloudRetailer) submission to AWS SellWith intake
- Thu 12/10: intake review window (expect follow-ups)

I'll upload the checklist to the Drive folder (link in thread) and attach a draft T&C excerpt in the Drive doc.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Tenant-proxy listing & fallback playbook — CloudRetailer joint demo bundle

Monica / Ben / Karthik —

Thanks for the clear summary. CloudRetailer preference: mirrored tenant proxies for AWS and GCP (one publisher per cloud), single mirrored listing for Azure is OK if the metering mapping is straightforward. We'll own seller-of-record in EMEA/APAC and are happy to be flexible in NA pending the SellWith terms.

Two quick asks from our side before you submit to AWS: 
1) Can you confirm the X-Partner-SKU header approach and whether Redwood can emit the header on behalf of the tenant proxy? We need that to ensure charge attribution in our billing pipeline.
2) Sophie will send a short redlined sample from our legal team later today for the T&C excerpt — will you confirm an approver on your side?

We're OK with the cadence Karthik proposed. We'll target Thurs 12/10 for the intake submission; Sophie and I will block time for a quick run-through Wed afternoon PT.

Linking our intake engineer for technical Qs: intake-engineer@cloudretailer.com

Best,
Liam
